text:
Anita: FYI perf-ci flagged a kernel pick regression in last night's autotune sweep for ampere-gpt2.
perf-ci-bot: nightly-autotune: 1713350000 summary -> 1 critical, 2 minor. critical: ampere-gpt2 seq=2048 +18% p50 vs baseline. logs: https://ci.redwood/amps/5678
Ben: which kernel path? selection or batching?
Anita: selection. autotuner swapped to knl_x86_v2 for deeper layers; observed latency bump on 2k microbench.
Carlos: running local microbench now.
Carlos: command I ran:
```
./bench --model ampere-gpt2 --seqs 512,1024,2048 --kernels knl_* --iters 60
```
Carlos: results: seq=2048 knl_v1 p50=118ms knl_v2 p50=140ms. matches CI.
Diane: note: our CI sweep uses cold KV cache by default. prod workload has ~70% KV hits; kernel tradeoffs differ.
Anita: good catch. I suspect autotuner scoring ignored cache-hit conditioning and emphasized p95 too much for long seqs.
Ben: propose update: make scoring function conditional on seq-length and kv_hit_rate. new_score = a*latency + b*cost + c*(1-hit_rate)*p95. a,b,c are tunable per model family.
Carlos: I'll patch microbench harness to run both cold & warm KV paths in nightly sweeps (flags --kv_warmup N). Also add a small verifier job that spins a runtime instance to validate picks with a warm cache sample.
Diane: also add automatic rollback rule: if selected kernel increases p50 by >10% on warm-cache verification, revert pick and mark candidate as flaky.
Anita: Can we also log kernel selection trace in CI artifacts (layer->kernel mapping, scoring vector) so root-cause is obvious?
Ben: yes and include flamegraphs + aggregated per-op timings.
infra-bot: updated perf config at infra/perf/autotuner.yaml (PR #912)
Carlos: I'll run a targeted nightly sweep after config change to make sure autotuner picks align with prod-like warm-cache.
Anita: Thanks. Long-term we should weight cost vs latency differently for long seq models (e.g., decoding-heavy) vs short seq.
Ben: Agreed. I'll draft the scoring RFC and post in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Diane: ping me for review, will add checklist for KV warm/cold tests.
Carlos: pushed test harness changes to branch knl-cache-bench, CI demo scheduled.
Anita: closing loop: after CI passes, we'll backfill autotuner history and re-run nightly to re-evaluate rolling candidates.
perf-ci-bot: note: follow-up sweep queued: https://ci.redwood/amps/5680
